gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (GAAP governmental funds statement) Total revenues: General Fund 62,131,983, Streets Fund 11,183,691, Other Governmental Funds 6,976,874 = 80,292,548. Detail: General Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule p9 Actual Total Revenues 62,050,213 + Streets Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule p10 Actual Total revenues 11,379,812 + nonmajor combining statement pp11-13 6,976,874 (ties to the Other Governmental Funds column) = 80,406,899. Gap -114,351 = (62,131,983 - 62,050,213 = 81,770) - (11,379,812 - 11,183,691 = 196,121). The two General/Streets schedules are printed on the budgetary basis; no fund column is missing and no line is duplicated. No fix.

Statement p4 Total expenditures: General 43,947,161, Streets 21,689,934, Other Governmental 9,660,907 = 75,298,002. Detail: p9 General budgetary Actual Total expenditures 44,443,263 + p10 Streets 22,723,695 + nonmajor combining 9,660,907 = 76,827,865. Gap -1,529,863 = -(44,443,263 - 43,947,161 = 496,102) - (22,723,695 - 21,689,934 = 1,033,761). Budgetary basis vs GAAP; no fix.

Statement p4 prints transfers gross: Transfers in General 2,833,621, Streets 7,179,500, Other Governmental 3,347,890 = 13,361,011; Transfers out (16,176,255) / (600,000) / (665,134). The budgetary schedules print only 'Operating transfers, net': General (13,342,634) (p9) = 2,833,621 - 16,176,255; Streets 6,579,500 (p10) = 7,179,500 - 600,000. Detail in = Streets net 6,579,500 + nonmajor gross 3,347,890 = 9,927,390. Gap 3,433,621 = General in 2,833,621 + Streets out 600,000, whose money is already inside the two net lines in detail; adding the p4 gross amounts would count it twice. No fix.

Statement p4 Transfers out 17,441,389 (General 16,176,255 + Streets 600,000 + Other 665,134). Detail out = General 'Operating transfers, net' (13,342,634) (p9) + nonmajor (665,134) = 14,007,768. Gap 3,433,621 = (16,176,255 - 13,342,634 = 2,833,621) + Streets 600,000, the mirror of the transfers_in gap (netted in the budgetary schedules). No fix.

Statement p4 Other Financing Sources: 'Lease proceeds' 431,241 in the General Fund column only (Total 431,241 = JSON debt_proceeds); 'Proceeds from sales of capital asset' 64,080 General Fund only (= JSON other_financing). The General Fund budgetary schedule p9 prints no lease proceeds, so 431,241 is in no detail line: added in the General Fund from p4. After the add, debt-proceeds detail = 431,241 = debt_proceeds. The remaining non-transfer other-financing detail line is p9 'Proceeds from sales of capital assets' 13,691 (budgetary basis), the same row as p4's 64,080 (GAAP): non-transfer OF detail 13,691 + 431,241 = 444,932 vs debt_proceeds + other_financing 431,241 + 64,080 = 495,321; difference 50,389 = 64,080 - 13,691 is the budgetary vs GAAP basis of the sale-of-assets row. Adding the p4 64,080 would count that row twice, so it is not added.
